<h2>v5.111.0</h2>
<h3>Minor Changes</h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Enable <code>output.module</code> by default with <code>futureDefaults</code> on ESM-capable targets. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#22088</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Remove <code>experiments.outputModule</code>, set <code>output.module</code> to emit ESM instead. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#22011</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Add <code>output.copy</code> to copy files and directories into the output directory. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#21938</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Accept a file URL in any spelling Node reads where an absolute path is taken. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#22012</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Minify inline CSS and JSON via <code>renderEmbeddedSource</code>, exporting webpack's own. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#21993</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Export <code>cssMinify</code> and <code>htmlMinify</code> on <code>css.syntax</code> and <code>html.syntax</code>. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#21953</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Make <code>processResult</code> async and let a tap rename the asset it rewrote. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#21854</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Lower a CSS spelling a target cannot read and write a color fallback before one. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#21926</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Allow optional filesystem cache build dependencies. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​xiaoxiaojx</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#21849</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Add <code>output.environment.topLevelAwait</code> and await every async ESM entry. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#21915</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Add <code>unusedSymbols</code> and <code>pseudoClasses</code>, and evaluate a CSS color function. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#21927</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Drop an implied shorthand slot, fold a math function, tighten color conversion. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#21929</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Add <code>module.parser.javascript.specNamespaceObject</code> for spec namespace objects. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#22049</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Drop what is already said or only a gone engine reads, add <code>lowerUnsupported</code>. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#21931</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Add <code>normalizeUrlAttributes</code>, <code>mergeScripts</code>, boolean and token switches. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#21960</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Minify an event handler attribute, and name the production each script body is. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#21968</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Add source-map, asset, module, bailout, federation hints; group config checks. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#21961</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Lower CSS nesting, <code>:dir()</code> and custom at-rules; gate case folding and escapes. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#21950</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Add <code>optimization.minimize.css.mergeDistantRules</code> to join rules across a gap. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#21969</a>)</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3>Patch Changes</h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Minify an embedded body through the embedded path, dropping three html options. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#21936</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Take a minified <code>style</code> attribute's answer whatever quoting it needs. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#21936</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Name chunk imports in the chunk loader, not at each import site. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#22076</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Repair hashed names; under HMR bake hashed url maps and reload moved css names. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#21916</a>)</p>
</li>
</ul>
